summary: Lesson 4 only. The spec says students are not required to calculate the total resistance of two resistors in parallel, so the 1/R formula and its beyond-the-course label go and the higher-only wrapper is dropped. The qualitative rule stays (n13 key fact, n16). The branch-current worked example is in scope and is kept. There was no parallel-resistance practice question here: the 6-mark question is the I-V characteristics practical, so it is untouched. Knowledge checks and glossary were clean.
